disposition_reason: Table 2 prints per-sample and summary concentrations of eight elements including lead in 13 geophagic kaolinitic clays from two Nigerian deposits.

study.design: Field sampling of geophagic kaolinitic clay deposits with trace element analysis and health risk assessment
study.origin: Lakiri deposit (Ise Formation, Abeokuta Group, Eastern Dahomey Basin) and Ubulu-Uku deposit (Ogwashi-Asaba Formation, Niger Delta Basin), Nigeria; outcrop faces dug to 60 cm
study.market: not market samples; collected from deposits
study.method: LA-ICPMS (193 nm excimer laser, Agilent 7700) for V, Cr, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Pb; XRF (2.4 kW Rh tube) on fused beads for Fe
study.qa: USGS BHVO basaltic glass and powder reference materials used as standards; recoveries not tabulated
